evidence.decorateButtons:
scripts/scripts.js — requires a.closest('strong') or a.closest('em'); a bare alone in a

is left untouched; emits p.button-wrapper > a.button.{primary|secondary|accent}
evidence.decorateBlock: scripts/aem.js — adds .block + data-block-name, wraps in div.<name>-wrapper, section gains .<name>-container
evidence.decorateSections: scripts/aem.js — wraps default content in div.default-content-wrapper; an empty section div stays in the DOM (no removal), hence main .section:empty { display: none } in styles.css
